lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance clusters are organized into five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Each cluster exhibits a sharp central maxima with radiating intensity spikes, forming a regular 2D grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae, creating the primary anchor points for the stellate high-luminance blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal features are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, defined by a distinct light-to-shadow vertical pixel gradient running the length of the visible midsection.

other_distinctive_markers: Four distinct, elongated silhouettes with high-contrast edges are clustered ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
